scenarios.name: assistant-collapsed
scenarios.note: The assistant add-on collapsed: the launcher in the corner

scenarios.name: assistant-empty
scenarios.note: An agent online and no conversation yet: the welcome text and three suggestions; Escape collapses it

scenarios.name: assistant-conversation
scenarios.note: A conversation: bubbles, an accepted proposal, a pending one and the agent still working

scenarios.name: assistant-proposal
scenarios.note: A reply with a proposal arrives while collapsed: a badge counts it, and opening shows its card

event.text: I drafted it for your review.

scenarios.name: assistant-waiting
scenarios.note: A proposal no reply opened (an agent's, from a terminal over MCP) still gets a card to review

scenarios.name: assistant-offline
scenarios.note: No agent connected: the status says so and a banner explains how to connect one

scenarios.name: assistant-history
scenarios.note: Past conversations: the header's button lists them, newest first; one goes on where it was, and the one shown is kept in its place; one is deleted; New conversation keeps the one shown and empties the panel

expect.is: It follows the system's setting now.
Add a Review column between Doing and Done.

scenarios.name: assistant-models
scenarios.note: The model picker in the header: the person's default, the provider's models with the default marked, and a choice kept for the app (the default itself kept as '')

scenarios.name: assistant-files
scenarios.note: Files: two attached to the next message, as cards in the composer; one sent, and a proposal's asset and run-once step

scenarios.name: assistant-actions
scenarios.note: A reply's copy and retry: copy says so for a moment; retry asks the request again. While the agent works, the send button is a stop button: it cancels the request and says so

scenarios.name: assistant-point
scenarios.note: Pointing at an element for the next message: Point steps the panel aside and the element under the pointer is outlined, with the hint; a click picks it (the app's own click doesn't run) and the panel comes back with it as a chip above the field, then sending shows it in the conversation

scenarios.name: assistant-point-keys
scenarios.note: Pointing by keyboard alone: the shortcut starts it with the panel closed, the arrows walk the elements, Enter picks; the shortcut again and Escape cancel, keeping the one picked

scenarios.name: assistant-dark
scenarios.note: The conversation in the dark theme: every colour is a token

scenarios.name: assistant-rtl
scenarios.note: Arabic, right to left: the panel mirrors and the strings are translated

scenarios.name: assistant-runs
scenarios.note: Commands an agent ran or asked to run, as cards: one that ran (Undo), one the person denied, one waiting for their yes (Run, Always allow, Don't run; its title and arguments on one line each) and one only the window may allow; the launcher counts the waiting ones; scrolled up, the one that ran; then the dark theme
